name: ss4focus
description: OPTION-4 GIVES THE KEYBOARD TO THE CARD'S CONSOLE AND LEAVES THE IIGS SCREEN WHERE IT WAS.  With a Second Sight card in slot 3 and sscon up as ttyv3's display, the console shell echoes a marker built by expansion (so the typed line cannot satisfy it), Option-4 is injected, and a login name is typed.  The name must reach ttyv3's getty: its ring (read through the vcbank registry, VC 3) holds 'login: qqfocus', and the card is still drawing.  The IIgs screen must NOT hold 'qqfocus' (a name no boot line carries; 'root' is in 'root on sd0'): had the focus stayed on the console the shell would have echoed the name as a command and complained about it, and had Option-4 switched the SHR screen the marker's console would be gone.  This is the one-keyboard contract on real hardware -- Option-1..3 bring the keyboard back and switch the screen, Option-4 moves only the keyboard.  Discriminates: make _Vc_DrainSwitch's card arm store _kVcActive as well and the screen shows ttyv3; drop the arm and the shell gets 'qqfocus'.  The border is the canary: after Option-4 the SHR border carries the card console's colour (border_check.py reads $C034's low nibble), the one visible sign on the IIgs screen that the keys go to the card.
